title: En sık 30 düzensiz fiil
explain_tr: En sık kullanılan fiillerin çoğu **düzensizdir**: geçmiş hâli (**V2**) -ed almaz, ezberlenmelidir. *go → **went**, see → **saw**, eat → **ate***.

Gruplarla ezberlemek kolaylaştırır. **Aynı kalanlar:** *put–put, cut–cut, cost–cost, let–let*. **-ought/-aught:** *buy–bought, bring–brought, think–thought, teach–taught, catch–caught*. **i → a:** *drink–drank, swim–swam, begin–began, sing–sang*. **ee/ea → e:** *meet–met, feel–felt, keep–kept, sleep–slept, leave–left*.

Diğer çok sık olanlar: *be–was/were, have–had, do–did, go–went, get–got, make–made, say–said, come–came, take–took, give–gave, know–knew, write–wrote, find–found, tell–told, sit–sat, stand–stood, read–read* (okunuşu /red/!), *pay–paid, lose–lost, win–won*.
Olumsuz ve soruda **did** varsa fiil yine **V1** olur: *I **didn't go*** (✗ didn't went), *Did you **see** him?* (✗ Did you saw).
explain_en: Common irregular verbs have special past forms (go→went, see→saw). After did / didn't always use the base form.

pairs.wrong: We didn't went out last night.
pairs.right: We didn't go out last night.

exercises.prompt: Last night we ___ (eat) at a Uyghur restaurant.
I ___ (see) Ali at the station this morning.
She ___ (bring) some cake to the office.
He ___ (put) his keys on the table.
We swimmed in the sea every day.
answer: We swam in the sea every day.

exercises.prompt: I meeted my friends after work.
answer: I met my friends after work.
He did not know the answer.

exercises.prompt: My father teached me how to drive.
answer: My father taught me how to drive.

exercises.prompt:
Geçmişe çevir (yesterday ile):
I write an email to my teacher.
answer: I wrote an email to my teacher yesterday.
Yesterday I wrote an email to my teacher.
Yesterday, I wrote an email to my teacher.

exercises.prompt:
Soru cümlesine çevir:
She went to the doctor.
answer: Did she go to the doctor?
